Pendulum Impact Testers for Plastics Testing – Accurate, Reliable and Operator-Friendly 
Together with tensile and flexure tests, Charpy impact tests are the most frequently performed mechanical tests in the polymer industry. ZwickRoell’s HIT range of pendulum impact testers offer a solution that combines high precision with cost effectiveness. 
Pendulum impact testing of plastics 
Standard-compliant testing to Charpy, Dynstat, Izod and impact tensile tests, Method A/B with the HIT series of pendulum impact testers—be sure to hit your target with ZwickRoell!
